summary.en: Satoru Tamai takes Emi Maeda to his mansion to have a 4-person class reunion with Kazuma Sasaki and Yosuke Okawa, and Tamai reveals that he and Maeda are engaged, much to the surprise of the other two and partly to Sasaki's jealousy.

suspects: Emi Maeda, Kazuma Sasaki, and Yosuke Okawa
